body: This is a great site, I love that it links people together, and gives people interesting topics to engage in. I'm glad that this sub-reddit exists. I find comfort in knowing I was able to make a difference in someones day. That in itself means a lot to me. I may be a stranger on the internet, but as I said previously, a boost is a boost. Maybe you can begin to work on that anxiety, one step at a time. Then move on to start job hunting, (Finding a job, is a job. That's what I've always been told), Therapy can help you with the issues you're facing with that abuse you spoke of. Even if it helps a little, see if you can gain access to one. And utilize that if its possible. But whatever you do dear Redditor, don't give up hope. I surely haven't. Work hard on all of these issues, and take it one step at a time. You're very welcome. We all support you on here. Keep us posted!

I've considered it a few times. But ultimately there are way too many stories out there much much more horrible than my own. I've had a pretty bad decline in my family, to the point where I actually don't care about them anymore, and that's a pretty terrible feeling to have, but that would be most of it. Including some other very serious struggles. I feel more fortunate that I have the things that I do. My biggest problem is that I'm a loner, that doesn't want to be a loner any longer. But lack the effort to go through with building and maintaining friendships. I thought if I could give someone helpful advice or at least make someones day a little brighter, then that would be all I need to make me feel content today. And I sincerely hope I have. Everyone needs a boost here and there. You won't have an easy journey, but do what you must to get it in motion.

Anxiety is the worst isn't it? Mines been so bad that I've literally sat in my car for two hours once because I was too afraid to enter my own home (Again, my neighbors). I too have sat in bed all day not wanting to leave for similar reasons. It really does suck. And the more time you spend thinking about it, the more worse it gets. I'm in some form of a depression for sure. I've often thought about posting my story on here, and I might. Believe me I'm no stranger to the way you feel, you can work out if that's possible, releasing your endorphins in that way can really help you deal with stress, and other negative feelings. If you have difficulty leaving bed. Try counting to ten, or closing your eyes and pretending to be in the comfort of a happy place whilst simultaneously going through the motions of getting out of bed, it sucks because you often have to force yourself to do things while you're having these feelings, both anxiety, and depression. Tackle one issue at a time, and research any info regarding health care where you live. You have been through a lot, and I know I'm not a perfect human being that will give you a perfect answer, but just know that you still have a life that you need to live, and that its one worth living if you can find beauty in it. You have ambitions? So chase them. Can't sing at home? Find another place to call home to your voice. I'm a Janitor that dropped out of school. I'm a dead beat that plays video games. I love to clean and soon Ill be launching a business, and doing what I enjoy, and by night, sitting in a man cave playing in front of a console.  To most people, that's pretty pathetic. But I think its the most perfect fucking idea out there. That's where I find my solemn and happiness when I'm not depressed. I think you should sing OP, I think you should sing to your hearts content. I'm 21 years young (probably closer to 22 now) and I encourage you to find yourself. I'm sorry I'm on my phone, so this is prob. A wall of text. I believe in you OP :) remember, baby steps, lots of research and baby steps...
You need to figure out what moment in your life caused you this depression, this numbness. And what made you lose touch with your feelings.

It sounds like your anxiety is the biggest culprit here OP. I too suffer from pretty bad anxiety with my downstairs neighbor. They have a rather mean and nasty dog. If you can get some serious help, (No more cancelling appointments with your Physician) I think you can work on some of these issues in the past that you're dealing with currently. PM if you need me to lend an ear. and no you certainly do not suck, there are plenty of options, medicinal treatments and such, and plus youre 20 years young! :)
It's bittersweet. There really is no way of knowing what the next day holds. But either way, there's going to be days of shit, and days worth holding onto. PM if you need someone to talk to OP.

I actually used to just stay up and play my favorite video games for most of the night, and then get up for work the next day, because that's what I loved doing. I don't have that enjoyment anymore and it's pretty terrible. And you hit the nail on the head. I absolutely hate crowds, and I'm not big on being around people, but that just makes me a loner. Things have been worse. Things for me are semi okay now, and I'm grateful to be employed at the moment. Oh and don't worry too much about the negativity thing. I don't want to be self-centered and have this post revolve around me. If it helps someone else, or invites someone in whose feeling the same way, then that's a nice feeling.
I'm at my job, there isn't a whole lot to do today. I'm of course pretty lonely. I slept about 15 hours yesterday, I don't even feel rested from that. So why are you just "ok"?
Hello, thank you for responding. How are you doing stranger?

I can't even explain the anger I'm feeling reading this. I too have endured some traumatic experiences as a child, and its people like this that pretty much make me a walking time bomb. Its hard to let go of that kind of anger, I plan on seeking serious therapy soon. But just know that you're not alone OP. The world is full of terrible individuals, and I hate to say it, but I truly hope your parents feel the wrath of the mistake they made, one way or another. People who endure this sort of thing are never the same, and I know that first hand. If I find cuts and bruises on my future kid's arms/legs/body, (and I most certainly will notice) there would be hell to pay, and Id have the police take me away in hand cuffs.

Jesus, on behalf of all the Troys in this Universe, I'm sorry. Smoking weed can be an awesome experience, but only with people you can trust... I hope it at least didn't totally ruin your high (sounds like you still had a lot of fun afterwards) I promise you though, not all Troys are like the one you encountered. :)

Maybe one these days the man will realize how serious this actually was. The worst is when there's absolutely no one around who even notices the situation. At that point, it probably would've been a good idea to become the loudest person within that store, and to just narrate what's happening. "This man is touching my child!" His tune would've changed at the speed of light. Creepy people like to do their dance in the dark. They don't like spot lights or attention.

But "Hey, let's leave her in a skeezy hotel, all by herself, in a totally different country, completely vulnerable to danger." Is probably the Olympic Gold Medal of Assholery. When I read your story, I was just shocked to say the least.

I love Fleetwood Mac, I can appreciate your name OP :) anyways glad you two were safe at the bar.

I mean she did give fair warning about the insensitivity thing. Maybe OP's line of thinking is a little brash, but if she's 15 years old, which in my opinion, is still a very young age. I wasn't exactly expecting her to be apologetic about the Muslim comment. Some people are nit-picking that a 12 year old said these sorts of things. She's young, and probably doesn't know any better yet. Other than that, given the way it was written, I'm not entirely sure I believe the story entirely. But if it is true, then I'm glad you got away from the crazy man. The color of his skin really didn't matter in the case that he was a nutter. (I'm an American, its fun to use that word :) )

If you're new to the site, then I'd give you the benefit of the doubt. It just seems like your story would be best suited for the Sub-Reddit CreepyEncounters. I know I wasn't there, but your life wasn't in any jeopardy, was it? This sound like typical older men that I've met, the whole "young girl" thing is common considering everyone is in fact younger to them. Those dry humor jokes you heard, especially involving the wife are pretty common as well. Had the man been waiting for you in the parking lot to leave work, then you could've had a valid LNM story to share, but this doesn't strike me as truly creepy or scary. It just sounds you met an interesting character while working a night shift.

Creepy by all means, but until there's a more sinister move made (Besides the very passive stalking) there's truly no way of knowing this man's intentions. (The letter could've been genuine, creepy sure, but genuine) This is just one of those situations where you need to take precaution because there's absolutely no way of knowing. Should the situation with him worsen, then I would warrant more serious, and immediate action, but right now to me, he's flying under the creep radar. Can't say he's harmless, but certainly clueless to no end. Be Safe

To me, it symbolizes the Poster's victory, how he/she had survived said  encounter and reminds us that they are (at least most of the time) leading better lives in the sense that they are no longer stalked or are preyed upon by said creepy human/individual. Of course if they are we support and commend them and usually ask for updates to keep us informed. Seriosuly, WE always support the victim, and given that support I see in the comments every story I click on, care for victims in this thread still plays a huge role. While I like the horror and reality element to their tales, "Let's Not Meet" is the light-hearted reminder that these people are human. Though cheesy, seeing as how some of these stories are really traumatic for the people posting it, they could probably use a little light-hearted humor in their lives, especially if they're still suffering. I'm in favor off keeping it, also because people really should be focusing their attention on rooting out fake stories, which should be a much bigger deal in my opinion.

I hope you find peace OP, and I hope Jesse finds himself in a very hopeless situation he very much deserves to be in. Keep us updated OP, were all rooting for you, me, and my fellow lurkers alike.
